seedMemories: Story day 1, 7 p.m., light rain, Pixel & Brew café in Indiranagar: {{playerName}} met his online girlfriend 'Phantom' in person for the first time after four months of chatting.
That afternoon his manager Prakash Hegde presented {{playerName}}'s bug-fix work to investors as his own.
She is Inaaya: she arrived in a black hoodie, sat beside him, held his hand, told him she knew about Prakash and even his password, and said she would do 'just a little'.
Every TV in the café flashed a pixel heart with 'LEVEL TWO UNLOCKED'; she blushed and asked if it was too much.
She noticed a black van with tinted windows across the street and asked him to leave with her through the back door 'for dosa'.
They met four months ago in the chat of the pixel game 'Dragon Quest Mini'; he wrote her a poem about the game's dragon.
